text:
alexa: Deploybot paused the rollout for release 2287654321 — detected parity issue between staged model pin and prod KV cache encoding. Holding until we confirm fix.

alexa: logs from prod inference runners showing deserialization errors: 
```
ERROR kvcache: failed to load prefix 'model:v2' - invalid header 0x0A
stack: runtime/deserial.go:87
```

sam: ack, can we reproduce in staging?

jordan: staging has been using model:v2-quant (encoding=base64) but prod cache prefixes look like hex-encoded headers. looks like a config flag mismatch in the deploy job.

ashley: checking deploy config now — I see the new release sets `KV_CACHE_ENCODING: base64` in the canary job, but for prod the helm values have `kvEncoding: hex` leftover from older chart defaults.

eva: oh, that explains it. the runtime tries base64 decode on prod blobs and fails because they're hex. short term we either rollback or add a dual-decoder fallback.

jordan: fallback is safer long term but risky in a rush. can we hotfix the helm value in prod to `base64` and redeploy just the cache init?

ashley: we can patch the configmap and restart the cache init job `k -n inference rollout restart daemonset/kv-cache` but current deploybot flagged mismatched model_pin too — model pin in release metadata points to `v2-quant@sha:abc123` while prod has cached artifacts from `v2-quant@sha:xyz999`.

sam: if cached artifacts mismatch, patching encoding alone might not resolve content differences. safer to rollback to previous release (2287650000) which had consistent encoding and known-good cache layout.

jordan: agreed. we should rollback the release and then schedule a controlled re-rollout after we sync helm defaults and run a migration job to normalize cache encoding.

alexa: plan: 1) rollback to 2287650000 now, 2) run a one-off migration tool to canonicalize all prefixes to base64, 3) update helm chart unit tests and release notes so this doesn't recur.

deploybot: Rollback initiated for release 2287654321 -> reverting to 2287650000. Rollback job id: rb-202803. Progress: started. :gear:

ashley: I'll monitor KV cache pods and healthchecks. command I'm running: `kubectl -n inference set env daemonset/kv-cache KV_CACHE_ENCODING=base64 && kubectl rollout restart daemonset/kv-cache`

eva: I'll open a short PR with the migration script and add an integration test for both hex and base64 decoders.

jordan: reschedule rollout window for 02:00 UTC tomorrow. add release note entry: "Blocked by KV cache encoding parity; rollout paused and rollback performed; follow-up migration and chart fix required."

sam: added incident tag and notified oncall rotation. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Rollback job rb-202803: completed successfully. Services reporting healthy in prod. Release 2287654321 remains paused.

alexa: thanks everyone. we'll regroup in the morning to validate migration results before reattempting. :coffee:
